function: Joint learning of RSU communication and radar beamforming, hybrid active-passive RIS reflection weights and V2X spectrum reuse to maximize V2I sum secrecy rate (p. 3, 6).
system: ISAC RSU, ULA Nt=16 transmit, Nr=8 receive antennas; M=4 single-antenna CVUs, L=3 V2V pairs, single-antenna Eve; hybrid active-passive RIS, 30-60 elements; band not stated (p. 3, 10, 11).
method: Hierarchical deep reinforcement learning: outer-loop DQN for discrete spectrum allocation, inner-loop TD3 for continuous beamforming and RIS weights; trained offline, executed online (p. 7, 9).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rician RSU-RIS and RIS-user links (3 dB), Gaussian RSU-user links, path-loss exponents 2-3, outdated CSI via Bessel correlation; no dataset (p. 3-4, 10).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated in the same simulated environment; results swept over speed, Rician factor, power, RIS elements, outdated-CSI factor and V2V links; retraining per setting not stated (p. 10-13).
baselines: Learned: HDDPG [49], variable-rate HDDPG [50], DQN [31], TD3 beamforming-only; non-learned: SCA with alternating optimization [15], passive RIS (p. 10-13).
metrics: Convergence reward, sum V2I secrecy rate, V2V and V2I data rate, radar mutual information, RMSE of target angle estimation; FPOS count (p. 10-14).
complexity: Analytical FPOS (floating-point operations) expressions for actor, critic and DQN networks; stated higher than traditional DQN; no measured runtime (p. 9-10).
q1_support: p. 4: "obeys a Rician distribution [15]" for the RSU-RIS link; the other links are zero-mean Gaussian (p. 3) with hand-set path-loss exponents (p. 10): custom simulator, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "We study the sum secrecy rate of all V2I links against the" average vehicle speed; all results are sweeps of parameters in one simulator, with no stated test of a trained model on unseen conditions or fine-tuning.
q3_support: p. 13: "our training scheme outperforms the AO method" (SCA/AO [15], non-learned) and p. 13: "technique has superior performance than HDDPG and DQN in" secrecy rate and data rate (earlier learned methods [49], [31]).
q4_support: p. 9: "To assess the computational complexity of the proposed hierarchical algorithm" the FPOS count is used; p. 10: "complexity of the proposed HTD3 algorithm is" followed by the FPOS expression.
q5_support: p. 10: "This section offers simulation experiments to confirm the" HTD3 scheme, so own simulated data; no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included. Area 5: beamforming and RIS configuration in an ISAC system (radar MI constraint, dual-function waveform), which wins over area 3; spectrum allocation is learned jointly with the beamforming, so above_phy does not apply.
